Heavy lanes on head 46edb3521: `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`. The run took 80.5 min: 115 steps, 1 failed, 0 stalled.

- `motion heavy: *` (every target, the known-fail steps included): passed.
- `app heavy: *` (every target, the known-fail steps included): passed, with one exception.
- `app heavy: operations`: failed, in two tests only:
  - `swarf_generates_blade_lying_axes_and_verifies_clean_full_band`
  - `advanced_swarf_adds_the_coarse_rungs_full_band`

  Both fail with the same 9 `RapidInPart` warnings (at 2141 ... 3110, `operations.rs:4984`) as on `upstream/main`. Issue #4315 records this failure. This PR does not change swarf code.

An earlier run on this head was void: the disk became full during the release build. This is the complete run.

Needs changes before merge. Suggested review label: `needs-rework`.

This is a safety-tier review. I read the full diff and checked the four changed NC blocks line by line.
The local trial merge is `d1ab71ef9bf80aabc8b7ba2042e5dda4c0b081af`, against upstream main `e902ee488e2d80cf84267d55898489e10400a073`.
Its first parent is the PR head above. The merge has no conflicts.
All checks ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-4316`. No GitHub runner was used.
Upstream main advanced to `ec314174e3afe7d88524c6cecb4b4afe871dd65d` during this review.
Its review rules did not change. These test results cover the recorded `e902ee4` base; I did not rebuild the newer base.

Requested before merge:

1. **Bound every radial peck loop by its full travel.** Class: numeric termination.
   [`crates/motion/src/drilling/cross.rs:236`](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/blob/46edb352143d5ce1806f55f67a88c5d98a9f1b87/crates/motion/src/drilling/cross.rs#L236) changes `depth` to the material depth.
   The guard at line 260 also uses that value, but the loop still starts at `p.r_d`.
   With a 2 mm drill, floor `-8`, explicit `Peck`, default peck and `r_d = 30000`, the PR returns 10,005 moves.
   Main refuses this input with `peck plan unusable`.
   With `r_d = 1e20`, the PR hangs because subtracting the step cannot change `t`.
   A five-second timeout stopped the running test. Both probes pass immediately with main's unchanged `cross.rs`.
   Keep the material depth for Auto. Use the full R-plane travel for the iteration limit, and refuse a step that makes no progress.
   Pin both cases. This rule must cover explicit pecks and Auto pecks.

2. **Invalidate caches made by the old generator.** Class: cached generator output.
   [`crates/motion/src/drilling/cycle.rs:92`](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/blob/46edb352143d5ce1806f55f67a88c5d98a9f1b87/crates/motion/src/drilling/cycle.rs#L92) changes Auto's emitted cycles and moves.
   The Auto parameter digest stays unchanged. The trial merge also leaves `GENERATOR_OUTPUT_VERSION` at `1`.
   A saved cache from current main can therefore remain current and post the old cycle without regeneration.
   Current main's [rule at the stamp](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/blob/e902ee488e2d80cf84267d55898489e10400a073/crates/app/src/operation/stamp.rs#L20) requires a version bump for this output change.
   Bump `GENERATOR_OUTPUT_VERSION`. Add a saved-Auto-cache test that reads Stale and blocks posting until regeneration.

3. **Add before/after UI screenshots to the PR body.** Class: UI review evidence.
   [`crates/ui/src/operations.rs:59`](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/blob/46edb352143d5ce1806f55f67a88c5d98a9f1b87/crates/ui/src/operations.rs#L59) adds a visible cycle choice.
   The body has no before/after screenshots. Link the old and new cycle combo.
   Keep the images on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch.

4. **List the changed program under `Goldens moved`.** Class: recorded program evidence.
   [`examples/catalog/2d/first-part/first-part.nc:487`](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/blob/46edb352143d5ce1806f55f67a88c5d98a9f1b87/examples/catalog/2d/first-part/first-part.nc#L487) changes four drill blocks.
   The body explains the change under `Effect on programs`, but it has no required `Goldens moved` list.
   Add that section and name the exact NC path. State the four `G83 Q6` to `G73 Q18` changes.

Local results:

- Quick gate: **82 steps passed, 0 failed, 0 stalled**, 49.0 minutes.
- Motion: 770 tests passed, 22 ignored, across 4 suites.
- App: 1,095 tests passed, 23 ignored, across 65 suites.
- UI: 1,820 tests passed, 8 ignored, across 10 suites. The tests used llvmpipe through Vulkan.
- All four new motion tests passed. All cycle-combo tests passed. The MCP suite passed all 57 tests, including `drill_deep`.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- Light lane: **6 steps passed, 11 light tests passed, 0 failed, 0 stalled**, 23.8 minutes. The release prebuild passed.
  `motion light: lib` passed 7 tests. `adaptive_troch_island`, `adaptive_troch_neck`, `adaptive_troch_parallel`, and `app light: pocket_pass_start` each passed 1 test.

Extra suites run:

- `example_catalog`: 44 passed, 4 ignored.
- `example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed.
- `example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed.
- `first_part_programs`, `golden_cl` (34 passed), `solid_law_goldens` (7 passed), and `recorded_post_streams`: passed in the quick gate.
- The catalog and golden checks ran by name. They cover the changed catalog program.
- No importer source or STEP fixture changed, so the extra kernel importer suites do not apply.

Mutations and safety probes:

I used copies under `/tmp/review-4316-probe`. I did not edit tracked sources.
The unmodified PR copies passed all four new drilling tests before and after the checks.

| Check | Mutated result | Restored result |
|---|---|---|
| Restore the old axial `p.r_z - bottom` Auto depth | Red: the spot test gets `[Peck, Peck]` instead of `[Drill, Drill]` | Green |
| Map explicit `Deep` to `CycleKind::Peck` | Red: the Deep test gets `[Peck, Peck]` instead of `[Deep, Deep]` | Green |
| Radial peck-budget probe at R=30000 | Red on PR source: 10,005 moves instead of refusal | Green with upstream main's unchanged `cross.rs` |
| Radial progress probe at R=1e20 | PR source timed out after the test started, exit 124 | Green with upstream main's unchanged `cross.rs` |

The NC comparison changes only four cycle words and peck values. Coordinates, depths, R planes, feeds and retracts stay unchanged.
Full heavy lanes were not run. Current upstream law does not require them for this P7 PR.
The author's heavy result names a pre-existing swarf failure in #4315; I did not use that result as my own test record.
A real machine was not exercised.

The environment has no `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`. The unique job identity above uses this review request's PR number.
I left the labels, title and draft flag unchanged, as requested. The review worktree and branch remain in place.
A maintainer will approve and merge by hand after the findings are fixed.
